output.reason: [ev-ff04fee04e63] says only that ApplicationSets now support GitLab "System Hook" webhooks, which is a new capability. The only environments it affects are those where a GitLab System Hook delivers events to the ApplicationSet webhook endpoint. That GitLab-side setup lives outside the cluster, and no manifest or Helm value shows it. The proposed exposure flags every environment that uses an ApplicationSet, which is too broad. Its v1beta1 version operand also has no support in the evidence.

correction.statement: ApplicationSet webhooks now support GitLab "System Hook" events. This applies only to environments that use ApplicationSets and where a GitLab System Hook is set up to send events to the ApplicationSet webhook endpoint. No static input shows that GitLab-side setup.

of.needed: whether a GitLab System Hook (as opposed to a project/group webhook) is configured to deliver events to the ApplicationSet webhook endpoint
